name.description: The name the game shows for this thing.

note.description: A sentence about what the game did.

tile.description: The tile the settlement stood on.

description.description: The description the game shows for this thing.

label.description: The label the game shows for this thing in its UI.

body_part.description: The body part to operate on, by def name.

pawn_id.description: The pawn's numeric id, as the pawn list reports it.

send_messages.description: Whether the game writes a letter about it.

pawn1_id.description: The numeric id of the first pawn.

pawn2_id.description: The numeric id of the second pawn.

label.description: The label the game shows for this thing in its UI.

area.description: The allowed area's name, or empty to let the animal roam.

pawn_id.description: The pawn's numeric id, as the pawn list reports it.

description.description: The description the game shows for this thing.

label.description: The label the game shows for this thing in its UI.

carried_by.description: CarriedBy names the pawn whose hands hold this animal, empty when nobody does, and CarriedTo where that carrier's job is heading (fox #3668).

carried_to.description: The cell the carrier is heading to, empty when nobody carries it.

downed.description: Whether the animal lies down and cannot move.

faction.description: The faction the animal belongs to, as the game names it.

health.description: The animal's hit points, 0 up to its race's maximum.

hunt_designated.description: Whether the colony has marked it for hunting.

id.description: The animal's numeric id, as the animal list reports it.

label.description: The label the game shows for this thing in its UI.

life_stage.description: The game's label for the animal's age: adult or baby.

manhunter.description: Manhunter is the game's own mental state: a herd in it attacks on sight, which is what a hunt of the herd runs into.

manhunter_on_damage_chance.description: ManhunterOnDamageChance is the race's own chance to turn manhunter when something hurts it (ThingDef manhunterOnDamageChance, 0..1; 0 when the def names none).

manhunter_on_tame_fail_chance.description: ManhunterOnTameFailChance is the race's own chance to turn manhunter on each failed tame attempt (ThingDef manhunterOnTameFailChance, 0..1; 0 when the def names none, fox #4191).

name.description: The name the game shows for this thing.

position.description: The cell the thing stands on, as x and z map coordinates.

predator.description: Whether the animal's race hunts other pawns for food.

pregnant.description: Whether the animal is carrying a pregnancy.

quest_lodger.description: QuestLodger is Pawn.IsQuestLodger: the animal stands on the map because a quest sent it, so it counts as the colony's by faction and still is not the colony's to kill.

sex.description: Sex is "male", "female" or "none" (the game's Gender values), and LifeStage the game's own label for the age ("adult", "baby").

side.description: Side is "tame" for an animal of the player's faction, the faction's own name for anyone else's animal, and "wild" for a pawn of no faction: only a wild animal is tamed.

tame_designated.description: The two designations a run sets and then looks for: the game keeps them on the animal, not on a cell, so no map read of designations tells a marked animal from an unmarked one.

tameable.description: Tameable is TameUtility.CanTame, the same check the tame order makes.

trainer.description: The numeric id of the colonist who trains it, when one does.

follow_drafted.description: Whether the animal follows its master when drafted.

follow_fieldwork.description: Whether the animal follows its master during fieldwork.

pawn_id.description: The pawn's numeric id, as the pawn list reports it.

master_id.description: The numeric id of the pawn the animal should follow.

area.description: The allowed area the animal is kept in.

follow_fieldwork.description: Whether the animal follows its master during fieldwork.

master.description: The name of the pawn the animal follows.

master_id.description: The numeric id of the pawn the animal follows.

race.description: The animal's race def name, e.g. "Muffalo".

trainables.description: One entry per trainable the game offers for this animal.
